facts.value: Do not travel or change employers while your STEM OPT Extension application is pending.
Log into your SEVP Portal account and update your current Post-OPT employment. Correct your current employer’s end date. Input your new employer’s information.
Submit a form I-983 for the new STEM employer.
Go to the MyISSC eForm Portal, click on F-1 STEM OPT on the left side bar and choose the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm.

For the question 'Is your STEM Extension application still pending with USCIS?' make sure to select 'yes' and then choose the option of 'Change to a new job – STEM OPT still pending' and complete and submit the eForm.
Your SEVIS record will be updated to reflect the reported changes and an updated I-20 will be issued.
To update USCIS with your change in employment, upload your new I-20 in the Unsolicited Evidence section of your STEM OPT application in the USCIS portal.
